recs.stt: Amazon's new role-playing game can help you build your AWS skills
recs.x:
Alright I was slightly cynical going in, but this doesn't seem too bad of a way to learn. Runs well in the browser, some clear presentation, and I can see its appeal towards a younger crowd or a crowd that's comfortable with gaming in general.

But mainly I like that their loading screen appears to use 'The Internet' box from IT crowd. [link]
One of my absolute favourite shows. what a gem - [link] . Also one of the best bits in my opinion - [link] . For those who have never indulged - Enjoy :-)
